div.div:
Local strength < 1: noise an encoded coarse RGB crop and run the remaining DDIM steps. At strength = 1 (app default), start from fresh noise.
Inference uses EMA U-Net + EMA mask decoder. The original RGB VAE and text encoder stay fixed. No weights are updated.
